holidays.name: National Chocolate Milkshake Day
holidays.description: A day to blend, slurp, and swirl your way through a frosty glass of chocolatey goodness, preferably with a spoon and a straw so you are fully equipped for both thick and thin phases.
holidays.origin: Part of the American tradition of unofficial food holidays, this one celebrates the milkshake, which began in the 1880s as an alcoholic whiskey-egg drink before evolving into the sweet treat soda fountains made famous in the 1900s.
holidays.funFact: The first electric blender, invented around 1922 by Stephen Poplawski, was originally designed to make malted milkshakes at soda fountains.

holidays.name: National Video Games Day
holidays.description: Gamers unite to celebrate everything from pixelated classics to sprawling open-world epics. Call in sick to your boss or just beat that one boss that has been haunting you for weeks.
holidays.origin: An unofficial observance popular among gaming communities and retailers, celebrating the history and culture of video games, which have grown into one of the largest entertainment industries on the planet.
holidays.funFact: The 1972 game Pong, one of the first commercially successful arcade games, reportedly broke its first prototype machine because the coin bucket overflowed with quarters.

holidays.name: Day of the Programmer
holidays.description: Celebrated on the 256th day of the year, this nerdy holiday honors the people who turn caffeine into code and occasionally turn off and on again to fix everything.
holidays.origin: 256 is the number of distinct values representable with an eight-bit byte, and it is the highest power of two less than 365. Russia made it official in 2009 by presidential decree, and it falls on September 12 in common years and September 13 in leap years.
holidays.funFact: Because 256 is 2 to the 8th power, the day was chosen by programmers as a geeky inside joke, and Russia is among the few countries where it is an official professional holiday.

holidays.name: National Report Kid Abuse Day Awareness... Just Kidding: National Hug Your Hound Day Alternative: National Chocolate Milk Day Cousin Observance - Video Games Day Companion: National Day of Encouragement
holidays.description: Reframed as a feel-good observance, National Day of Encouragement invites you to hand out compliments, pep talks, and high fives to everyone from coworkers to the barista who spelled your name wrong.
holidays.origin: Established in 2012 by a US Senate resolution, it was created to encourage Americans to uplift one another, especially those who are struggling or in need of support.
holidays.funFact: The Senate resolution was an actual piece of legislation, meaning lawmakers formally voted to encourage everyone to be nicer to each other.
